title: Star Rating (VisualElements)

scenarios.title: Star Rating applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Star Rating (BtnStarRating) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Star Rating state codec and per-star fill decision are pinned host-free
scenarios.expected: The persistent state codec round-trips every field (count, invariant rating, icon mode, frame flag, color) and rejects foreign or malformed tags; the per-star fill decision resolves full, dim and partial-gradient stars with the historical >= 0.5 solid fallback.

scenarios.title: Star Rating creates exactly one shape in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Star Rating default command on an empty slide adds exactly one shape (measured shapeCountDelta=1), reports execution, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
